packet.title: EXI encoder with built-in grammars
packet.summary: Encodes a tree as a schema-less stream, bit-packed or byte-aligned, byte for byte as the oracle does.

body.p: After 8.4. EXI 1.0, sections 5, 6 and 8, from the encoder's side; namespace declarations from in-scope namespaces ().

item.p: Mechanism: src/exi_encoder.c, a walk of the tree over an explicit stack () that sends events through the grammar machine of 8.4.
Owns: that file, tests/exi_encoder_test.c, sxml_exi_encoder_encode in src/exi.c.
Done when: every encode check of the sets of 8.4 passes and is in the ratchet.
